name: Akabane Tomomi
source: The “queen” who leads the Forum on the Case Against Uniform Abolition. Was chosen by the academy as a model for its official uniform, motivating her to argue for uniforms to remain mandatory. Likes to be the center of attention, and idolizes the entertainment industry. Dislikes people who garner sympathy by seeming weak, leading her to see Isshiki as her nemesis. At her core, she’s an older sister-type who looks after those around her.
